meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 给它一段文字,它会按 12 个认知维度各打 1-10 分,并输出一份认知画像:维度分数、六组张力图、主导与阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹和叙述总结。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人怎么思考、剖析写作或说话风格、比较两人的思维风格,或提到「DHDNA」「思维模式」等说法时接管。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维方式,给出认知画像
say.note: 输出 12 维度评分与张力图

say.text: 把这篇和另一篇放在一起比较思维风格
say.note: 生成两份画像并做对比合成

say.text: 用 DHDNA 给我自己做一份思维画像
say.note: 基于当前对话打分,会提示样本局限

howto.what_en: Give it any text and it scores the author on 12 cognitive dimensions (1–10), then outputs a profile: dimension scores, six tension pairs, dominant and shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, and a narrative synthesis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze how someone thinks, profile a writing or speech style, compare thinking styles between people, or mention "DHDNA" or "thinking pattern".

say_en.text: Analyze how the author of this text thinks and give a cognitive profile
say_en.note: Scores all 12 dimensions and draws a tension map

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles in these two passages
say_en.note: Produces two profiles plus a comparison synthesis

say_en.text: Profile my own thinking style with DHDNA
say_en.note: Scores the current conversation and flags sample limits
